test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language

A + B means ‘A is the son of B’

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’

Based on the above, how is P related to T if ‘P × Q − R ÷ S + T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is

 to B
 
 

Given: P × Q − R ÷ S + T

P × Q → P is the wife of Q.

Q − R → Q is the brother of R.

R ÷ S → R is the father of S.

S + T → S is the son of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2af3a808fb36bb20d59b78d2e73bfed4cd49b3471aa8333c9f90a7e6ba4b8395.png] 

Thus, P is the sister-in-law or husband's brother's wife of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
